source:
# Static geometry: animation is configured in the separate pane.
box base -32 -12 -2 64 24 2
material base 0.25 0.3 0.38 0.6 0.4

group rotor
  position -18 0 5
  box blade -11 -2 -1 22 4 2
  cylinder hub 0 0 -2 3 4
end
material rotor 0.95 0.45 0.1 0.5 0.3

group slider
  position 0 0 2
  box carriage -3 -4 0 6 8 4
end
material slider 0.1 0.7 0.9 0.3 0.3

group indicator
  position 25 0 4
  sphere lamp 0 0 0 3
end
material indicator 0.3 0.9 0.4 0 0.35
animationSource:
# Four seconds: one revolution, one slide, one pulse.
animation loop 4
  track rotor
    key 0 euler 0 0 0
    key 4 euler 0 0 360
  end
  track slider
    key 0 position base.position.x base.position.y base.position.z
    key 2 position (base.position.x + 12) base.position.y base.position.z
    key 4 position base.position.x base.position.y base.position.z
  end
  track indicator
    key 0 scale 1 1 1
    key 2 scale 1.6 1.6 1.6
    key 4 scale 1 1 1
  end
end

# A separate two-second clip, selected independently of main.
animation sway loop 2
  track rotor
    key 0 euler base.euler.x base.euler.y (base.euler.z - 30)
    key 1 euler base.euler.x base.euler.y (base.euler.z + 30)
    key 2 euler base.euler.x base.euler.y (base.euler.z - 30)
  end
end
